verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt is confirmed by a probe returning HTTP 200, and it states that every docs page is also served as Markdown by adding `.md` to its path. The API docs also publish a machine-readable spec explicitly intended for AI coding tools. The 404 at the bare `/.md` root and the 404s at guessed OpenAPI paths on the docs domain do not contradict this, since the spec is documented at app.dover.com/docs/api.json. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the per-page Markdown variants and api.json resolve, and any evidence of an llms-full.txt or independent agent usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.dover.com/llms.txt # Dover Docs
Every page is also served as Markdown: add `.md` to its path
Use it to generate a client or to give an AI coding tool the exact endpoints and fields.
